_about: Public-domain William Penn (1644-1718), Quaker and founder of Pennsylvania, for the Word Hoard: the Collection of the Works (1726, two volumes), the Select Works (third edition, 1782, five volumes), No Cross, No Crown (Leeds, 1743, and London, 1842), Fruits of Solitude (1863), the Rise and Progress of the People called Quakers (1834) and a 1694 sermon, from Internet Archive scans and Project Gutenberg. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 34 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
